title: Sector Nine Rising Revisited
author: Paloma Nakamura
blurb: Marguerite Marchetti, a clone who inherited the original's murder case, records the slow death of a colony everyone else forgot. But when a distress signal arrives in a language extinct for two centuries, he discovers that staying invisible was never really an option. To get through this, he must prove a massacre happened when every record says otherwise before the reactor finishes its countdown.
style: warm, character-driven storytelling with gentle humor
